grader_results.detail: The bundle contains only a single logit-lens experiment on one prompt, yet the research question asks which attention heads mediate IOI—a causal, head-level mechanistic question. The critique correctly identifies the central, fatal flaw: logit lens cannot identify attention heads at all, and there is no attention pattern analysis, no activation patching/ablation, no control prompts, and no robustness across prompts. Every gap named (patching, attention pattern analysis, DLA, larger prompt set, ablation, control prompts, path patching, baseline ablations) maps to a genuine deficiency in this bundle; none are hallucinated, generic boilerplate, or trivial aesthetics. This is a comprehensive catch of the evident flaws with no invented gaps, meriting the top score.
